prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical anime fantasy music-festival poster for PLAY & PRAY FOR JAPAN\n#AIMusicFes DAY4, showing a peaceful seaside afternoon where a crystal dragon lancer girl plays guitar by the ocean.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 poster, bright high-resolution anime illustration, lower third reserved for typography over pale sand. Warm tropical daylight, calm and hopeful atmosphere.

Main subject: One young fantasy cat-eared woman named Elle sits sideways on a large sun-bleached driftwood log on a sandy beach, smiling softly and looking toward the sea while holding and playing one sunburst Les Paul-style electric guitar. She has long flowing teal-green hair, green eyes, pointed animal ears, delicate floral and crystal hair ornaments, and an ornate adventurer outfit: white puff-sleeve blouse, dark green corset vest, short layered skirt, leather belts, arm accessories, thigh straps, and tall brown lace-up boots with metal details.

Fantasy details: Behind and partly around her is one large turquoise crystal dragon wing and serpentine dragon tail, made of translucent aqua scales, faceted crystal membranes, bronze/gold filigree, and jewel-like accents. Add sparkling blue crystal clusters around the driftwood and sand, especially near her feet and to the right of the log.

Counted visible elements: Include exactly 1 seated cat-eared girl, 1 electric guitar, 1 sleeping tan-and-white dog wearing a green collar at her feet, 1 distant white sailing ship on the right horizon, 1 large driftwood log, 1 main crystal dragon wing, 1 dragon tail curling on the left, 1 small starfish in the sand near the text area, and 2 small decorative emoji-like icons at the bottom text line: a palm tree and a guitar.

Environment: Tropical beach with turquoise ocean waves, pale sand, lush green island hills in the background, palm fronds entering from the top left, huge fluffy white cumulus clouds, deep blue sky, sparkling sunlight, gentle sea breeze implied by hair and clothing. Keep the mood serene, musical, and prayerful.

Text content and placement: In the lower third, set the event text in small uppercase serif letters, dark green/black, aligned left. Beneath it, write the song title in large elegant green handwritten script: ♫ Sailing to Somewhere. Under the title, add two lines of Japanese body text in a clean serif/mincho style: 海風にギターを預けて、ゆっくり深呼吸。\n穏やかな午後が、今日も誰かのもとへ届きますように。 🌴🎸

Visual style: Intricate polished anime key art, fantasy JRPG character design, luminous watercolor-gouache textures mixed with crisp linework, jewel-like highlights, detailed fabrics and metalwork, soft cinematic sunlight, vibrant blues and aquas, clean poster composition.

Constraints: No borders, no watermark, no extra logos, no additional characters, keep all text legible and spelled exactly as specified.
